rationale.complete: Round 1 done: dated predictions, nulls, impostor table and rivals before data; synthetic validation on the real skeletons of all 17 periods (4 population worlds x 20 runs, plus pooled family/trait worlds) with four dated amendments before real data; replication on all 17 H18 periods (9 powered); 2 natives (G51 with timer-wake exponents and lab test; NE42, underpowered); engagement, reply-ranking and per-message-mention variants (the last labelled post hoc); confirm script frozen with a passing dry run (not run; needs a holdout pending-set builder). Missing: holdout run, per-agent load/role analysis.
rationale.faithfulness: The core claim is refuted consistently and with power: between-agent SD 0.09-0.20 vs ~0.45 needed, no bimodal period (0/9 powered), no agent near beta = 0, no lab effect (p 0.37), signature reversed (concentration rho +0.36). Scorecard A1 B1 C0 D0 E0 F2 G0 H0 I0; the 2 is on the instrument, not on the model.
rationale.usefulness: A clean negative control: dilution is one agent-level constant per period, so H18's J ~ N^-beta normalization needs no composition correction and swapping model families will not change it. No new operator lever.

one_line: Attention dilution is one narrow unimodal exponent per period (between-agent SD 0.09-0.20), not a mixture of thin attenders and thread followers.
